question.text: Will any of these AI companies (Lovable, DeepSeek, or Perplexity) have a funding round in November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if any of these companies has a funding round listed by TracXn with a date in November 2026: [Lovable](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/lovable/__fO6WUvzcx5q3814ietMd3kzGlRirsatzsTnpxmzLuMI/funding-and-investors),  [DeepSeek](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/deepseek/__1GrZ3pgoi2O-9tMSfF9ka6Sjybc1lgSSZ_qQqo5k2vE/funding-and-investors), or [Perplexity](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/perplexity/__V2BE-5ihMWJ1hNb2_u1W7Gry25JzPFCBg-iNWi94XI8/funding-and-investors).
question.fine_print: No other resolution source will be used in resolving this question.

research:
I couldn't find anything that settles this yet. The Tracxn pages are blocked to my fetch tool (HTTP 403), but search snippets of them show DeepSeek's newest round dated **2026-10-22**, which is October, not November. I found no confirmed November round for any of the three companies. The best lead is Perplexity's reported talks to raise at a valuation above $30B, which have been unconfirmed since August.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-30: All three Tracxn "funding-and-investors" pages returned HTTP 403 to my fetch tool, so I couldn't read them directly. Everything below comes from search-engine snippets of those pages. [Tracxn Perplexity](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/perplexity/__V2BE-5ihMWJ1hNb2_u1W7Gry25JzPFCBg-iNWi94XI8/funding-and-investors)
- **DeepSeek** on Tracxn: a $4.4B Series A dated 2026-06-16, and a Series B dated **2026-10-22** at about $15B, with Tencent and CATL as investors. [Tracxn DeepSeek](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/deepseek/__1GrZ3pgoi2O-9tMSfF9ka6Sjybc1lgSSZ_qQqo5k2vE)
- **Lovable** on Tracxn: newest round is a $400M Series C dated 2026-08-12, led by Menlo Ventures and the Scaleup Europe Fund. [Tracxn Lovable](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/lovable/__fO6WUvzcx5q3814ietMd3kzGlRirsatzsTnpxmzLuMI/funding-and-investors)
- **Perplexity** on Tracxn: about $1.72B raised over 11 rounds. The newest round is an undisclosed angel round dated 2025-12-05, and Tracxn cites a valuation as of 2026-01-09. So Tracxn does list small or undisclosed rounds. [Tracxn Perplexity](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/perplexity/__V2BE-5ihMWJ1hNb2_u1W7Gry25JzPFCBg-iNWi94XI8/funding-and-investors)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. No round dated in November 2026 has been found for any of the three.
- DeepSeek's large second round has already been dated October on Tracxn, so it won't count unless Tracxn adds a separate November tranche, or changes the date to match a later registry filing. As of the latest cited data (July 2026), no registry filing for the October round had been reported. [1023 Jack](https://1023jack.com/news/deepseek-made-its-name-doing-more-with-less-now-it-has-reportedly-raised-16-bill/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

I found no report that this round has closed. ## 4. Base rates
- **Perplexity:** 11 rounds on Tracxn from 2022 through December 2025, roughly one every 3 months. Valuations reported: $9B (Dec 2024), $14B (mid-2025), $18B, $20B (Sep 2025), about $21 to 23B (Jan 2026). I found no Tracxn-listed round in 2026 after January, so this is a gap of about 10 months. [aifundingtracker](https://aifundingtracker.com/perplexity-ai-valuation-growth-strategy/); [TFN](https://techfundingnews.com/perplexity-raises-200m-at-20b-valuation-ai-search/)
- **Lovable:** Series B in December 2025 ($330M at $6.6B), then Series C in August 2026, about 8 months apart. A November round would come only 3 months after the last one. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/12/lovable-confirms-new-13-3b-valuation-raises-another-400m/)
- **DeepSeek:** rounds in June 2026 and October 2026, about 4 months apart.
- **Combined:** in 2026, roughly 3 to 4 of the 10 months had a Tracxn-dated round for one of the three companies: January (Perplexity, if it is listed as a round), June, August and October. That works out to about a 30 to 40% monthly rate. But the company that just raised (DeepSeek) and the one that raised in August (Lovable) are less likely to raise again within weeks.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no prediction market on funding rounds for these companies.
- Kalshi, "When will Perplexity officially announce an IPO?": 14% before 2028-01-01, 38% before mid-2028, 57% before 2029. This is related but doesn't match the question. Perplexity's CEO has said the IPO target is 2028. [24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/27/perplexity-wants-a-30-billion-valuation-before-its-2028-ipo-nvidia-may-help-it-get-there/)
- The other markets collected (DeepSeek model releases, DeepSeek market share, App Store removal) don't bear on funding.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **Perplexity / Nvidia:** the round at over $30B could close or be announced. Talks have been pending for about 2 months. This is the most plausible way the question resolves Yes. Nvidia's earnings around mid-to-late November could bring disclosures.
- **DeepSeek:** a registry update in China, a later close or tranche, or Tracxn re-dating the round could create a November entry. I found no evidence of a separate tranche planned.
- **Tracxn timing:** Tracxn dates rounds by announcement or report date, and sometimes adds them late. A November round announced at the end of the month might not appear by 2026-12-01.
- **Lovable:** no reported talks. Secondary sales or tender offers would count only if Tracxn lists them as rounds.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) There is about one month left. The window is November 1 to 30, 2026, and the question resolves around December 1. For Yes, Tracxn must list a funding round dated in November 2026 for Lovable, DeepSeek or Perplexity, and it must appear on Tracxn by the time the question is resolved.

(b) The status quo is No. No November round is known or reported as imminent for any of the three. DeepSeek's big round is already dated October 22 on Tracxn.

(c) Base rate: in 2026, roughly 3 to 4 of the first 10 months had a Tracxn-dated round for one of these companies, about 30 to 40% per month. Two things lower that for November:
- DeepSeek just raised in October.
- Lovable raised in August.

So the base rate for November is about 25 to 30%.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes:**
  - On 2026-08-23, The Information reported that Nvidia was in talks to invest in Perplexity at a valuation above $30B. Those talks are still unresolved, and Perplexity historically raised roughly every 3 months.
  - Tracxn lists even small undisclosed angel rounds, for example Perplexity's on 2025-12-05.
  - DeepSeek's round has nearly 30 investors and has not been confirmed by DeepSeek. Tracxn could add a later tranche or a registry-dated entry.
- **For No:**
  - Perplexity has had no Tracxn-listed round for about 10 months, and the Nvidia talks have been pending for 2 months with no close.
  - DeepSeek's round is already dated 2026-10-22 on Tracxn.
  - Lovable has no reported talks.
  - Tracxn sometimes lags, so a round announced late in November might not show up before resolution.

(e) Scenarios:
- **No:** The Perplexity talks slip into December or 2027, or close but get dated outside November. DeepSeek's entry stays dated October, and Lovable is quiet.
- **Yes:** Perplexity announces the Nvidia-backed round at about $30B or more in mid-November, possibly around Nvidia's earnings, and Tracxn lists it with a November date. Or Tracxn adds a November DeepSeek tranche.

(f) I start from about 28%. I move up a little for the live Perplexity talks and for Tracxn's tendency to log small or duplicate entries. I move down a little for Tracxn reporting lag and for the absence of any concrete closing signal.

Probability: 30%

**(a) Time left and what is needed for Yes.** About one month remains: the window is November 2026, and resolution comes around 2026-12-01. Yes requires Tracxn to list a funding round dated in November 2026 for Lovable, DeepSeek or Perplexity. It must be visible by the time the question is checked.

**(b) Status quo.** No November round exists for any of the three. DeepSeek's latest round is dated 2026-10-22, Lovable's 2026-08-12 and Perplexity's 2025-12-05. Without a new event, the answer is No.

**(c) Base rate.** In 2026, about 3 to 4 of 10 months had a Tracxn-dated round for one of these three companies, a monthly rate of roughly 30 to 40%. Two of the three have just raised, though: DeepSeek in October and Lovable in August. That makes November less likely than the raw rate suggests, so the adjusted base is roughly 20 to 30%.

**(d) Evidence.**
- **For Yes:**
  - On 2026-08-23, reports said Nvidia was in talks to invest in a Perplexity round at a valuation above $30B. That round has not closed, and Perplexity has not had a Tracxn-listed round in about 10 months despite its historically frequent raises.
  - Tracxn lists small and undisclosed rounds, such as Perplexity's angel round.
  - DeepSeek's round has nearly 30 investors and is unconfirmed, so Tracxn could add a later tranche or registry-based entry.
- **For No:**
  - DeepSeek's round was already dated 2026-10-22.
  - Lovable raised $400M on 2026-08-12 and has no reported new talks.
  - The Perplexity talks have dragged on for two months with no sign of closing.
  - Tracxn sometimes adds rounds late, which could cut out late-November deals.

**(e) Scenarios.**
- **No:** The Perplexity deal slips into December or 2027, or it closes but Tracxn dates it by an earlier report. DeepSeek's round stays dated October. Lovable is quiet.
- **Yes:** Perplexity announces its Nvidia-backed round at over $30B in mid-November, and Tracxn lists it with a November date.

**(f) Adjustment.** I start from an adjusted base of about 25%. I estimate the individual paths at roughly:
- Perplexity: about 15%, since the pending talks are a real catalyst.
- DeepSeek: about 6%, through a tranche or re-dating.
- Lovable: about 4%.
